Calculate the reorder level, the reorder quantity, and how many weeks pass between deliveries. Describe the stock control chart. items.answer: Reorder level = 400 × 3 + 1,200 = 2,400 units; reorder quantity = 5,200 − 1,200 = 4,000 units; time between deliveries = 4,000/400 = 10 weeks.
